records.label: spacr.model_zoo.installable_backend_entries#1
records.source: A backend absent from the zoo teaches nobody that it exists, so each one is listed, and its ``source`` says where it stands -- ``installed``, ``installable``, ``installing`` or ``not installable here`` -- with the reason as its first note and its licence on the row. Installing one builds it an environment of its own under ``~/.spacr/backends`` and leaves spaCR's own environment alone.
records.context: A backend absent from the zoo teaches nobody that it exists, so each one is listed, and its ``source`` says where it stands -- ``installed``, ``installable``, ``installing`` or ``not installable here`` -- with the reason as its first note and its licence on the row. Installing one builds it an environment of its own under ``~/.spacr/backends`` and leaves spaCR's own environment alone.
records.translation: Bakendi sem er ekki í líkanasafninu kennir engum að hann sé til, svo hver og einn er talinn upp, og ``source`` hans segir hvar hann stendur -- ``installed``, ``installable``, ``installing`` eða ``not installable here`` -- með ástæðuna sem fyrstu athugasemd og leyfi sitt á röðinni. Uppsetning eins byggir honum eigið umhverfi undir ``~/.spacr/backends`` og lætur eigið umhverfi spaCR í friði.

records.label: spacr.model_zoo.scorecard_html#1
records.source: A paragraph of prose is what a tooltip used to show, and a reader comparing two models had to parse two paragraphs to find two numbers. The same table the model card prints answers that at a glance. Falls back to the prose when an entry publishes no metrics, because an empty table is worse than a sentence.

records.translation: Efnisgrein í lausu máli var það sem verkfæraábending sýndi áður, og lesandi sem bar saman tvö líkön þurfti að þátta tvær efnisgreinar til að finna tvær tölur. Sama taflan og líkanskortið prentar svarar því í fljótu bragði. Fellur aftur á lausa málið þegar færsla birtir enga mælikvarða, því tóm tafla er verri en setning.

records.label: spacr.model_zoo.scorecard_html#2
records.source: Metrics that hold none of the scorecard's keys -- a free-form note, a training loss under a name of its own -- are not a scorecard either, and return nothing too: a table of eleven "not recorded" rows would replace a two-line note that said something.
